blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust for Reinsurance & Commercial Lines — dlt networks, tokenization and verifiable credentials — shared truth with regulatory teeth applied to the reinsurance & commercial lines operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

Reinsurance and specialty commercial books trade in complexity: treaty structures, cat exposure, bordereaux reconciliation and capital optimization. The data flows between cedants, reinsurers and brokers are still largely spreadsheets — which is why settlement cycles and model confidence suffer.

items: Treaty settlement disputes rest on each party's numbers; evidence chains are procedural.
Ceded premium/loss bordereaux arrive in formats and qualities; reconciliation consumes analysts and hides data quality issues.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Smart Contract Engineering & Audit, Enterprise DLT Network Engineering, Blockchain Analytics & Regulatory Compliance from the Blockchain & Digital Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Bordereaux intake/reconciliation, Treaty settlement, Retro/capacity optimization) on Achala Ledger and Achala Sentinel. Governance inherits the sector frame — Solvency II / RBC among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Instruments as tokens — issuance, custody and lifecycle under securities-law discipline.
Contracts as production software — specification, formal verification and audit before value moves.
Proof, not paperwork — EUDR, DPP and chain-of-custody systems regulators and customers can verify.
shared settlement records between cedant/reinsurer/broker (disputes collapse)
